press_references.value: Suez Canal Bank explores integrated digital banking, investment services with Thunder, Visa

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank announced that it is exploring a new integrated digital banking and investment services initiative in collaboration with Thunder, Visa, and Modopay, aiming to leverage fintech and digital payments to enhance customer experience, pending Central Bank of Egypt approval.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Bank signs tripartite protocol with eHealth, eAswaaq to drive healthcare digitalisation

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank entered a tripartite cooperation protocol with eHealth and eAswaaq Egypt, affiliates of eFinance Investment Group, to jointly finance and digitise Egypt's healthcare sector by bundling bank funding with eHealth's Clinic Plus cloud platform and eAswaaq's marketing and client referral capabilities.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Bank, Alameda partner to integrate premium banking, healthcare services

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank and Alameda Healthcare Group entered a strategic cooperation protocol to integrate premium banking services with exclusive healthcare benefits for the bank’s high-net-worth and Privé clients in Egypt.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Bank joins Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank joined the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials to adopt standard methodologies for measuring and disclosing financed emissions and support green finance initiatives.

press_references.value: SCB signs protocol with e-Aswaaq Misr to boost SME financing, drive digital transformation

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank signed a cooperation protocol with e-Aswaaq Misr, a subsidiary of e-Finance, to expand SME financing through integrated digital solutions and support financial inclusion and digital transformation in Egypt.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Bank signs EGP 30m credit facility with Oliv

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank and Oliv announced a partnership via a EGP 30m credit facility to boost SME financing through Oliv’s digital factoring platform in Egypt.

press_references.value: Governor of CBE meets with Chinese counterpart to Strengthen Financial Cooperation

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank, China-Africa TEDA Investment Co., and CIPS Co. Ltd. signed an MoU to promote the use of the Chinese yuan in the Egypt-China Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Bank, Mastercard send lucky cardholder to Venice Film Festival in exclusive ‘Spend & Win’ campaign

partnership_announcements.description: Suez Canal Bank and Mastercard partnered to launch the 'Spend & Win' campaign, offering cardholders a chance to win an exclusive trip to the Venice Film Festival, highlighting their commitment to innovative customer experiences.

press_references.value: Suez Canal Authority says it can handle challenges, major lines to resume transit after stability

partnership_announcements.description: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA) is maintaining strategic partnerships with major shipping lines, including Maersk, to enhance canal transits and services. Maersk is expanding its investments in Egypt, particularly in East Port Said and Damietta Port, and prioritizing the Suez Canal as a primary route for the Gemini Alliance with Hapag-Lloyd.

about_short_description.short_description: Suez Canal Bank is an Egyptian joint stock company that offers retail and commercial banking services.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Current and savings accounts for individuals, including Egyptian- and foreign-currency options, deposits and withdrawals, cheque services, and debit-card access.

identifier.value: Certificates of Deposit and Time Deposits

product.name: Certificates of Deposit and Time Deposits
product.description: Fixed-term and floating-rate savings products in Egyptian pounds, US dollars, and other currencies, with interest paid periodically or at maturity.

product.name: Loans and Credit Facilities
product.description: Personal and specialized lending programs for salaried employees, self-employed customers, professionals, pensioners, youth, education, and fully secured borrowing.

product.name: Credit and Debit Cards
product.description: Payment cards, including Visa and Mastercard credit cards and debit cards, for cash withdrawals, purchases, and controlled domestic or international spending.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Online and mobile banking services for individuals and businesses, including transaction viewing, account servicing, and digital access to banking products.

product.name: SME Banking and Finance
product.description: Financial and non-financial services for small and medium-sized enterprises, including business financing and support for production and expansion.
